concept.title: Concept
concept.tagline: A career tracker that grows alongside your career, instead of asking you to fill out a static profile once.
concept.loopEvidence: Evidence (a quick update, a certificate, project notes...)
concept.loopSkillPicture: Skill picture (persisted, not recomputed each view)
concept.loopReflect: Reflect: resume export, job gap check, growth guidance toward your goals
concept.loopNote: This isn't a straight line — it's a loop. Every reflection (a resume, a gap check, a growth suggestion) feeds back into what you check in about next, so each pass adds to the same accumulating skill picture instead of starting over. Every screen in this app — Dashboard, Profile, Learning Log, Skills — is a different view onto that same append-only evidence log.
concept.selfHostedBody: No accounts, no multi-tenancy. Run your own instance the way you'd self-host a personal finance tool — your career data stays on your own server.
concept.freeTextTitle: Free-text skills, not a fixed taxonomy
concept.freeTextBody: Skills are stored as the natural language the LLM extracts from your evidence, or that you type directly — not normalized IDs from a predefined list.
concept.pluggableLlmBody: Talks to any OpenAI-compatible chat completions endpoint — a cloud API or a local Ollama server. Configured from Settings, not hardcoded.
concept.evidenceNotAssessmentBody: Skills mostly come from things you already have (a resume, a certificate, a project description) rather than from filling out a skill matrix from memory.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Configure the LLM connection. Any OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions endpoint works — cloud API or local Ollama.
settings.backupHint: Download all of your career data (evidence, skills, profile, goals, learning log, links, resume history) as a single JSON file. Your LLM connection settings are not included.
